PKM Unique.Description: Someone really wanted to have a mobile 12.7x108 mm caliber light machine gun in their hands. But the thing is, we can't allow just anyone to wield this kind of power, so we made this weapon as a good middle ground
PKM Unique.Explanation:
PKM >Heavy Pay2Win Gun<
This unique variant blends the best traits of the Heavy Machine Gun Variant - reduced recoil and increased fire rate - with the .50 BMG caliber from the Pay2Win Variant. Not to mention, we are bundling a 100-round .50 BMG magazine with it!

AK-74 Unique.Description: When you don't shoot this weapon in full-auto fire mode, Kalashnikov turns in his grave, generating enough power to supply a medium-sized city
AK-74 Unique.Explanation:
AK-74 >Overclocked Meta<
This unique variant blends the best traits of the Overclocked Variant - its fire rate and gun-cooling capabilities - with Meta Variant stats

G36 Unique.Description: Are you tired of constantly changing magazines because they only fit a few weapons? Are you tired of managing calibers for all the weapons you possess? This gun says "No longer!" to these issues!
G36 Unique.Explanation:
G36 >All caliber<
This unique variant can straight up use all magazines and all bullets!

AXMC Unique.Description:
Extremely fast, small, and able to fit in a pocket. It's not about the weapon, but about this blue creature. I have no idea why it is even here... We need to...
>>> PUT HIM OUT OF HIS MISERY <<<
*Proceeding to insert it into the gun*
AXMC Unique.Explanation:
AXMC >Handy Pocket-sized Hypersonic<
This unique variant blends the best traits of the Handy Variant - ergonomics - Pocket-sized - the ability to be placed in a holster slot - and Hypersonic - incredible muzzle velocity

M700 Unique.Description: When you're running out of good guns, still want to play one, and at the same time feel creative with your choices
M700 Unique.Explanation:
M700 >M4A1 No-bolt<
This unique variant has M4A1 stats with matching magazines and a 1-shot burst mode

AKMS Unique.Description: A worn-out and old weapon that received a few upgrades during its lifespan and is now just perfect
AKMS Unique.Explanation:
AKMS >Actually meta<
This unique variant has much better stats than its Meta counterpart

M1A Unique.Explanation:
M1A >Faster Control-Fire<
This unique variant has a special recoilless full-auto fire mode, but with a much faster fire rate than its predecessor

APB Unique.Description: Try not to look through the scope. Thank you for your consideration!
APB Unique.Explanation:
APB >Russian Stormtrooper<
This unique variant has a special scope with unique statistics and is chambered in .366 TKM
9 out of 10 Russian Stormtroopers choose .366 TKM as their favourite ammunition - amazing!

Filter: Nightforce Magmount 34mm ring scope mount for Stormtrooper Use Only

STM-9 Unique.Description: Fully automatic FURY at your immediate disposal
STM-9 Unique.Explanation:
STM-9 >Automatic FURY<
This unique variant combines Automatic and FURY Variant capabilities. It has full-auto and a special 2-shot burst fire mode, in addition to being chambered in .277 FURY (6.8x51 mm)

AS VAL Unique.Description: Point and click without issues - guaranteed! Or your money back!
AS VAL Unique.Explanation:
AS VAL >Unbreakable P&C<
This unique variant allows firing the special Point & Click burst mode without damaging the weapon in the process
